name: radar-jammer
title: Radar jammer aircraft (mission 4 optional targets)
usage: Mission 4: two airborne jammers near the transports; radar jamming clears as each is destroyed. Pending independent safety review; not uploaded; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, call signs, serials, codes or glyph-like marks in mesh or texture; grey countershading, splinter camouflage, panel lines, door outlines, plain rotodome rib circles and stains only.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; the only markings are a plain dark-red fin-top band and plain rings behind the engine lips. Original design, not a copy of any real or game aircraft (low-wing twin with a T-tail, a lens rotodome on one swept pylon and wingtip pods).

noFaces.note: No faces or figures: no crew is modelled. Head-on, the nose is a radome in the body colour with no seam ring, dark panel or camouflage; the windscreen is a grid of small panes tinted only slightly lighter than the paint; the two engine fronts sit low and wide under the wings, below the windscreen, and the rotodome is a thin body-colour lens above. Nothing protrudes from the nose. Checked in preview-front, preview-closeup-front, preview-closeup-front-3q, preview-front-low, preview-front-high and preview-closeup-front-low.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: Unarmed electronic aircraft: no guns, missiles or stores; wingtip pods are smooth antenna housings. No damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original twin-turbofan radar jammer: low wing with 30-degree sweep and 5-degree dihedral, two podded engines, T-tail, a 14.4-stud lens-shaped rotodome on a single swept pylon aft of the wing, wingtip antenna pods and blade antennas. Unarmed.
sizeRationale: 59.3 studs span over the tip pods (58 at the wingtips) x 62.2 long. At the fighters' ~1.44 studs per metre a ~40 m twin-engine airframe gives about 58 studs: 2.4x the Vanta v2 span (24.6), clearly smaller than the 72-stud heavy transport it flies with, and still a large, slow target.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; not referenced from src/

scaleReference.note: Review aid only: an approved, already uploaded asset placed at in-game size for scale. Not part of this asset or its FBX.
